scope: Reuse the existing three-case formal campaign, separate evaluator ablation and blinded expert protocol. Development probes and assisted demonstrations remain separate.
case_freeze_rules: Use existing frozen brief, target and criteria exactly; a requested scope change creates a new version before collection, never an edit to already-observed evidence.
The formal calculator includes clear/reset behavior; the recent 17-case GUI diagnostic has a different selected interaction and is not a substitute for CALC-001 through CALC-008.

Hotel repository fixtures and mocked weather responses are deliberate controlled application inputs in these case definitions, not fake model inference. Retain their hashes and labels; do not imply live service integration.

Use one clean owner-committed platform revision and the same protocol for comparable final runs. Capture loaded code, runner images, dependency receipts and configured model identities, not just git HEAD.
Never resume or relabel the frozen C94 attempt as a new result. Fresh runs receive fresh workspace and workflow IDs.
Finalize every started formal run as COMPLETED, FAILED or ABORTED; preserve failures and partial evidence without replacement by assisted output.

metric_collection.source_contract: case_metric_bindings plus verify_metric_binding_provenance read actual JSON Pointer values from content-addressed evidence; missing measurements are not zero.
metric_collection.runtime_and_oracle_evidence: Only executed independent tests/browser observations can satisfy requirements and acceptance criteria; nominal manifest coverage, schema success and self-certification do not.
metric_collection.cost_provenance: Separate observed API token usage from local wall time and paid GPU allocation charges. Unknown costs remain unavailable; never hardcode remote compute cost to zero.
metric_collection.aggregation: Descriptive ratios and raw numerators/denominators by case; retain None for absent denominators and report how many observations contribute to each mean. Do not infer population effectiveness from three cases.

comparison_tracks.component: User Twin artifact evaluator, not source generator
frozen_inputs_required: exact adapter ID and weight/configuration hashes
same payload, schema, prompt version, decoding policy and token budget
EXTERNAL_EXPERT_SAMPLE records and semantic family keys
complete training example hashes and family exclusions
frozen fixture order, language balance and submission schedule
comparison_tracks.interpretation: One paired output per input is descriptive and sensitive to sampling. Run a separately frozen repetition study before making stability claims; do not silently retry or select the best sample.

comparison_tracks.cross_base_interpretation: A different-size or different-base coder is a system comparison, not an adapter ablation; do not label it ADAPTER inside the existing same-base ablation contract.
comparison_controls: same platform revision and source prompt contract
same independent acceptance oracles frozen before inference
same output/context/repair budget when supported, otherwise report differences
identical isolated runner and dependency policy
all failed, truncated and rejected outputs retained
comparison_tracks.sampling: Record temperature and all actual decoding controls. The current StructuredGenerationRequest exposes no seed field; do not claim reproducible seed-controlled decoding merely from a planned ordering seed.
metrics: independent acceptance pass count and denominator
verified compute cost and repair count
excluded_from_unseen_confirmation: any training/curriculum family, translation or close paraphrase
any output used to adjust prompts, validators or model selection

selection_prerequisites: Select 60 distinct eligible held-out paired outputs; bind every pair to immutable fixture and raw generation hashes. Do not duplicate outputs to reach the quota.

Decide the review unit before sampling. The current 11-item rubric requires reviewable requirements, architecture, code, tests, interface and process/provenance material. A standalone evaluator JSON may not support all items.
If any rubric item is inapplicable, create and approve a new protocol/schema with N/A and analysis rules before collection; never manufacture a 1–5 judgment or silently drop a rubric item.
Have the thesis owner arrange qualified independent reviewers, availability and the institutionally required participation/consent arrangements; the agent must not invent reviewers or responses.
blinding: Use create_blinded_pair and build_expert_review_package; retain the identity key separately under researcher control.
Use neutral opaque output IDs and filenames; inspect text, metadata, URLs and embedded content for identity leakage beyond the automatic key-name sanitizer.
Keep reviewer instructions identical and randomize candidate A/B order using a recorded privately stored randomization seed.
No prompt/model tuning after collection starts; no use of frozen expert feedback for training.
collection: Preserve original score forms, comments and timezone-aware timestamps.
Validate exact package hash, reviewer assignment, duplicate prevention and complete rubric through validate_expert_ratings.
Unblind only after complete expected collection through decode_expert_ratings_after_collection.
reporting: Publish raw counts of base/adapter/tie preferences and per-item means/deltas, retaining reviewer and pair IDs for transparent paired interpretation.
Report missing/withdrawn collection honestly; do not fill gaps with model-generated judgments or unblind an incomplete v1 package.
Treat 120 forms as two ratings on 60 pairs, not 120 independent applications; do not claim statistical significance or target-user behavior.

data_provenance.formal_case_definitions: Researcher-authored controlled case scenarios; frozen bytes and canonical domain hashes are pinned above.
data_provenance.training_and_synthetic_curricula: Explicitly synthetic, engineer-authored or model-generated with exact producer identity; not empirical participants. Exclude evaluation records, semantic family aliases and translations from training.
data_provenance.model_outputs: Preserve exact HTTP bytes, request/schema/prompt hashes, base/adapter/tokenizer identities, decoding settings, token usage, native elapsed time, decisions and source lineage.
data_provenance.human_ratings: Only directly collected independent expert judgments; raw comments retained; no auto-generated scores.
data_provenance.storage: Public blinded package separate from private keys, account/participant identities and raw credentials. Large data/checkpoints remain external with content hashes.

technical_validation_scope.interpretation: Execution fixture/Level D qualification validates a specific runner/configuration; a generated JVM calculator probe separately tests model code. Neither replaces the three formal Web cases or expert/user evidence.

work_packages.task: Verify pinned case and protocol bytes, metric bindings and launch compatibility
Owner selects final platform commit, exact model conditions, independent unseen fixture set, runtime validation receipts and review unit
Run the three governed case workflows with gates, independent tests/browser checks and original evidence capture
Harvest only actual measurements, verify JSON Pointer provenance and finalize successful/failed/aborted runs
requires: actual formal run workspace and evidence

work_packages.task: Generate/freeze eligible base-adapter outputs, construct blinded expert package and separate keys
Collect 120 genuine expert rating forms, validate completeness, unblind and aggregate descriptive results

existing_command_templates.purpose: Prepare workspace for an existing workflow; preflight enforces clean matching revision

current_claim_limits: This plan creates no formal run, expert sample, participant record, rating, promotion or scientific result.
Historical September19 GUI/model comparisons are diagnostic; the failed autonomous Web run stays failed and the assisted calculator remains separately labelled.
The frozen protocol is descriptive only. Target-user usability research would require a separate protocol and actual users.
The plan checker confirms byte identities and contract coherence, not environment readiness or method validity.
